rules: Design defines pure protocol and independent outer adapters; production cannot import another adapter or tooling.

modules.responsibility: Validate the shared v1 wire message and constants
modules.interface: Unknown input becomes a validated notification or a descriptive rejection

modules.responsibility: Map OpenCode v1 session and tool events to notifications
modules.interface: V1 plugin hooks return promises; failures log without interrupting agents
modules.effects: Owns config file reads, SDK session/log calls and bounded HTTP delivery

modules.interface: Authenticated loopback HTTP and workspace commands
modules.effects: Owns HTTP listener, terminal environment, installation and VS Code workspace commands

modules.responsibility: Present notifications on the local computer
modules.interface: Validated deliver command chooses app/system according to focus settings
modules.effects: Owns VS Code UI and native notification process adapter

modules.responsibility: Build, validate, package and smoke-test deliverables
modules.interface: npm script commands fail nonzero on unmet contracts
modules.effects: Owns task-local builds and isolated test processes

contracts.rules: Protocol is pure; adapters import only protocol and declared external effects; production cannot import scripts/tests.

checks.expectation: Actual graph passes; injected forbidden dependencies are rejected.
Strict typing, event/HTTP/presentation tests and documentation checks pass.

checks.command: npm run package && npm run test:extension
checks.expectation: Both VSIX archives are valid and isolated VS Code extension host smoke passes.
Markdown and local documentation links validate.

checks.command: npm run build && npm run test:native
checks.expectation: Real OpenCode v1.2.0 using a local fixture model delivers a completion through the bundled plugin and authenticated router.

documentation: Russian README and English development, design, verification and release documentation.

review.reconciliation: Inspected all task-owned source, manifests and lockfiles, checks and build scripts, tests, docs, and workflows against scope; every file is covered. Generated dependencies, bundles, caches and assets are ignored. No sibling repository changes are included. Fresh review accepted effect ownership, interfaces and dependency contracts after corrections and executed checks.
